description: Turn an address or place name into coordinates, or coordinates into a street address, anywhere in the world (OpenStreetMap). Returns the formatted address, city, region, postcode and country. Pay per call; ask the pricing tool for a quote.

query.description: Address or place, e.g. "1600 Pennsylvania Ave, Washington". Use this or lat/lon.
